name: fairbuild-bid-leveling
description: Fairbuild Bid Leveling: subcontractor bids tabulated and leveled by bid package: scope items a bidder left out priced at your plug values, bids missing addenda or a bid bond, late bids, and bids far below or above the others. Shows the lowest responsive leveled bid per package. Drafts scope clarification letters. Never awards, rejects or notifies a bidder.
